title: FragmentSender facade retains mutable authoritative retry and session state
description: Security review: frozen dataclass state can be changed with object.__setattr__, and _set_security_state is callable. Active exact senders can lower attempts for unlimited retransmissions or alter status/fragments/manager. Keep authoritative attempts/status/fragments/binding only in manager-owned private records keyed to exact facade; expose snapshots and ensure facade mutation cannot affect retry/output/session semantics.
